prompt:
The inventory app in src/ has no notion of currency. Add a `currency` field to items and carry it through every layer: model.mjs, parser.mjs, validator.mjs, serializer.mjs, report.mjs and cli.mjs. Keep the existing file names and exports; src/index.mjs must also export `SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES` and `DEFAULT_CURRENCY`.

Rules:

1. Supported currencies are USD, EUR, GBP, JPY and CAD. `SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES` is the array ["USD", "EUR", "GBP", "JPY", "CAD"] in that order and `DEFAULT_CURRENCY` is "USD".
2. Model: `createItem(raw, defaultCurrency = DEFAULT_CURRENCY)` returns an item that also has `currency`. The value is trimmed and uppercased. If `raw.currency` is missing, null or blank, the item gets `defaultCurrency` (uppercased).
3. Parser: the CSV may have an optional `currency` column in any position (header names stay case insensitive). `parseInventory(text, { defaultCurrency })` takes an optional second argument; blank cells and files without the column get that default, otherwise USD. Currency codes are uppercased by the parser, and an unknown code is kept and not rejected there.
4. Validator: an item without a currency (undefined) counts as USD. Any other currency must be exactly one of the supported codes (no normalizing, so "eur" or "" is invalid) or the error `currency must be one of USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD` is added. JPY has no decimals: for a JPY item whose price is otherwise a valid number but not an integer, add `price must be a whole number for JPY`. New errors go after the existing ones, the JPY price error before the currency error.
5. Serializer: `toCsv` writes the header `sku,name,qty,price,currency` (currency is always the last column) and formats each price with 2 decimals, or 0 decimals for JPY. `toJson` writes the keys in the order sku, name, qty, price, currency, with the price still a number. In both, an item that has no currency is written as USD.
6. Report: each item line becomes `SKU | Name | 3 x 19.99 USD = 59.97 USD` (amounts use the same decimals rule, then a space and the code). The single `Total:` line is replaced by one line per currency, `Total (EUR): 10.00`, in alphabetical order of the code and with the amount formatted for that currency, still followed by `Items: N`. An item without a currency is reported as USD, and a report with no items has no total lines.
7. CLI: add `--currency CODE` (also `--currency=CODE`). It sets the default currency for rows whose currency is blank or missing; rows that name a currency keep it. The code is uppercased first. An unsupported code makes `run` return exit code 2 with stderr `unsupported currency: <CODE>` (uppercased), and `--currency` with no value gives exit code 2 and `missing value for --currency`. The usage text should mention the new option. Validation errors keep the format `line N: message` with N the line number in the file, so a blank currency cell under `--currency JPY` with a price of 2.5 reports `price must be a whole number for JPY`.

The tests in test/ describe the old formats. Update them to the new behavior and add tests for the currency rules, then make sure `npm test` passes.
